title: preview rotation and pinch zoom pan

commit.merge_subject: merge: preview rotation and pinch zoom pan

description:
Owner request 2026-11-11 section 6: the preview could only ever be
seen at fit-to-box; inspecting detail or checking focus on a small
screen was impossible. This adds pinch-to-zoom (1x..5x) with
one-finger pan while zoomed, keeping the video inside the preview
box at all times.

WHAT
- ui/editor/ZoomPan.kt (new, pure): the decision object. State is
  zoom + pan with pan in BOX-FRACTION units, making the math
  aspect-free (portrait and landscape clips run identical rules).
  clampZoom (1..5x - 5x keeps zoomed detail real at the preview
  tier's ~1080-1280px frames), panBound (zoom-1)/2 per axis (the
  content's half-overflow: at 1x the bound is 0, so no panning),
  clampPan/panBy (the video never leaves the box), and pinch with
  zoom-around-focus: the content point under the anchor centroid
  stays under the moving centroid, derived for the CLAMPED zoom so
  a pinch against the ceiling
changed: feat: manual rotation via one rotation source of truth
feat: pinch zoom and pan on the clip preview
